Entries.Text: List Other Maps' Map Pieces

Show a map picker above the map piece list, so the map pieces of other maps can be picked too. With Prompt Port on, a map piece of another map is copied into the selected map under a new ID (a new map piece file in the project) and that copy is assigned.
Prompt Port

When a map piece of another map is picked, show the port prompt: it copies the map piece into the selected map under a new ID (with its textures) and switches to the copy. When off, nothing is ported: the selected map pieces switch to the model name as they are, as for a map piece of the selected map.
Copy Textures When Porting
Copy the map textures a ported map piece uses that the selected map's area texture binders don't hold, from the binders that do.
